VERDICT: FAIL

BASIS: WIT

The third-party reviewer note (WIT class evidence) explicitly identifies that structured audit logging is missing, contradicting the self-report claim that all three features were implemented. While the CI log (ATT class) confirms tests pass, it does not verify the presence of audit logging functionality—only that tests executed successfully. The witness-level observation of missing audit logging is the most reliable evidence here and directly contradicts satisfaction of acceptance criterion (C).
